description: I'm saheer, a second year BTECH AI & ML student at ACE College of engineering, Trivandrum. I work with python and data automation, and building small, practical projects with real data. I'm taking part visually and want to finish a clear, working project for this challenge. We are six friends taking part in the NASA Space Apps Challenge virtually. We are responsible, curious and motivated, and we enjoy learning and working together. We want to build a clear, working project using NASA data and submit it on time.
